composition_summary: Reviewed the volatile tail and preserved it unchanged. The task is a single class-22 pure-logic draft (pc-check-timeout-ms) using the target typed-inputs interface, not a submission or activation. The body validates raw candidate data with inputs.get() (never direct access), treats bool as not-integer, enforces exact integer 0..7500 inclusive, and returns {valid, timeout_ms} with null on invalid/missing/null — no exceptions, no coercion, no imports/host/IO, and a module-level result assignment on every path. Proposed one class-22 payload with only name/description/content. No provider capabilities were observed (target_provider_metadata has no protocol_capabilities), so no prompt repair was justified; the draft is provider-agnostic. Q1, observed behavior and human Q2 precede activation.

payload.name: pc-check-timeout-ms
payload.description: Pure-logic guard: validates a raw candidate timeout_ms as an exact integer in 0..7500 inclusive. Returns {valid, timeout_ms} where timeout_ms is the original integer when valid, else null. No exceptions, no coercion, no imports, host calls or I/O.

adjusted_volatile_messages: We need to validate raw timeout values before configuring a service.
